about.heading: About
paragraphs: I'm a developer focused on Discord tooling and backend services. Most of my work lives inside discord.js ecosystems — slash commands, interactive components, moderation flows, and API integrations.
Outside of bots, I build small web tools and write clean JavaScript. I care about readable code, sharp UI, and shipping things that actually work.

experience.description: Building and maintaining the delivery bot stack. Handling slash commands, order flows, and Discord API integrations with Node.js.
Shipped custom Discord bots for clients — moderation, economy systems, ticket tools, and music features.
